description.en: Mississippi is a state in the Southeastern and Deep South regions of the United States. It borders Tennessee to the north, Alabama to the east, the Gulf of Mexico to the south, Louisiana to the southwest, and Arkansas to the northwest.
description.zh-CN: 密西西比州是美國東南部及深南地區的一個州。北鄰田納西州，東接阿拉巴馬州，南鄰墨西哥灣，西南與路易斯安那州接壤，西北則與阿肯色州相鄰。
